title: WAMTA Call for Papers data (cfp.yml)
description: Drives the per-year /cfp page rendered by _includes/cfp.md.

description.description: Multi-paragraph workshop description / motivation. Markdown allowed.

special_issue.description: Optional markdown block describing the linked Special Issue (journal, link).

contact.description: Optional markdown block with contact email/people for CFP questions.

submission.description: Optional markdown block with submission instructions (EasyChair link, format requirements).

sections.description: Optional list of titled sub-sections (e.g. 'Abstracts', 'Full Papers', 'Best Paper Award').

dates.description: Optional list of important CFP-related deadlines (free-form value text).
